article: 2024年掲載の日本株22銘柄：配当リスクと最新情報の確認先
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and all twelve translations, all 22 company names and codes, historical publication framing, risk statements, finance metadata, and official links.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and retained 2024-12-22 as the publication date; recorded lastmod 2026-11-24.
Removed unsupported current “recommended/high dividend” framing because the article contains no dividend yields, selection criteria, or calculation date.
Reframed the 22 names as a historical copy of the original article list; did not claim current listing, yield, or suitability.
Added that dividends can be reduced or suspended and share prices can fall below purchase price.
Directed readers to current exchange and issuer disclosures before making an investment decision.
Changed the category from it-technology to finance and added official JPX, FSA, and JSDA references.

post/高配当株まとめ/index.en.md.summary: Compared the full Japanese list and twelve translations with Tokyo Stock Exchange and investor-risk references; recast the unsubstantiated high-yield recommendation as a dated 2024 historical list and added current-data checks and dividend/principal risk.

meaning.note: Compared all 22 names and securities codes across languages and clarified that the original 2024 list had no yield data, selection criteria, or calculation date and is not a current recommendation.

terminology.note: Checked company names, Japanese stock/security codes, dividends, yield, issuer investor-relations disclosures, TSE listed-company search, and the distinction between historical list and current screening.

mathematics.note: The article lists company names and securities codes only; it provides no dividend-yield figures or calculations.

code.note: The article contains no executable code or commands.

links.note: Added and checked the TSE Listed Company Search, Japan FSA/Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission investment risk guidance, and Japan Securities Dealers Association securities risk material.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
No company-by-company current dividend yield, financial health, or suitability analysis was performed; the tickers are reproduced from the original 2024 article and should be rechecked before use.
This is general historical information, not individualized investment advice; dividends and share prices can change.
